audited_head: Nine week 3 batch 2 rows, all 36 files in out/storytime-review/batch-44/pages, all nine refs, and three extra color-line pairs with Nan's reference.
summary: Eight story rows are clean. The cover has loose brushes outside the children's hands and a tan post that is missing from line art. All three extra rows are clean.

defects.description: Two loose brushes lie on the low table, although the goal says every brush is in a hand.
defects.retry_hint: Remove the loose brushes from the table and keep each brush in a child's hand.

defects.description: A tan vertical post stands behind the left easel in color and does not appear in the line file.
defects.retry_hint: Remove the tan post from both files or draw the same post in both files.

l2-w03-cover-paint.goal_check: Six children and Teacher Kim show; Nan has her named look; easels, paint pots, and the floor paw print show; no text shows. Teacher Kim's head begins near 19% of page height, so it reaches about 11 percentage points into the top 30% band. The named brush placement does not match.
l2-w03-cover-paint.retry_hint: Remove the loose table brushes and reconcile the tan post across color and line.

open_items_judged.Ben's clumped hair: Not a defect under the bar. Ben still reads as the reference boy at book size; the hair is a style deviation.
open_items_judged.Pip has about ten spots: Not a defect. The goal requires the named paint colors, and all seven colors show; it does not set an exact spot count.

l2-w03-story-page-it-is-purple.sheet_color: Purple only on the sheet. Kim's green cardigan and navy trousers stay outside it.

K1.goal_check: Nan touches her nose with one finger and laughs. Her nose shows in color and line art. The touching hand reads as one pointing finger, not a five-digit hand.

K2.goal_check: One large brown acorn-shaped nut rests on Nan's open hand in close view. The line art keeps the nut and hand clear. No extra finger stands out.

K3.goal_check: Nan's head faces left, opposite the right-facing reference. Her profile nose reads clearly in both files for tracing practice.

line_gray_scan.method: A Node script with sharp counted every grayscale pixel whose value was not 0 or 255.
